enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Move arm. Turn to back. Remain still. Continue sleeping.

Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Wash body. Turn off shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out bowl. Take out cereal. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Pick up bowl. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in dishwasher. Close refrigerator.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting ready and packing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out bag. Open bag. Put laptop in bag. Put phone in bag. Put keys in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Change into scrubs. Wash hands. Check schedule. Visit patient room. Take vitals. Administer medication. Update patient records. Consult with doctor. Attend meeting. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Visit more patients. Complete paperwork. Change out of scrubs.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Check phone. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Place on counter. Turn on oven. Open microwave. Put food in microwave. Set timer. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Place vegetables on baking sheet. Put baking sheet in oven. Close oven. Set timer. Wait.

Open oven. Take out baking sheet. Place on stove. Turn off oven. Pick up plate. Scoop food onto plate. Carry plate to table. Sit down. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Cut food. Chew food. Swallow. Drink water. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open browser. Type website. Click link. Scroll page. Type email. Send email. Open document. Edit document. Save document. Open game. Play game. Close game. Shut down computer. Stand up.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Wash hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down by reading or watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Close book. Put down book. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Change channel. Turn off TV. Put down remote. Lie down.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Move arm. Turn to back. Remain still. Continue sleeping.
